note: Kice spec §9/§10/§11/§21/§29 (major-update-spec). The guaranteed major rival is the first rival (stage 2), made into a full rival record. Characters are semi-canon: each keeps Pokémon from its canonical teams (Gen 1 Blue/Gary, Gen 2 Silver, Gen 4 Barry, Gen 8 Hop), evolved and levelled to this game. Pools are families (first stages); the starter comes from the first-rival roll. Numbers below are the rules for studied moves, counter moves, Pokémon rivals and the sacrifice event.

monRival.note: Persistent Pokémon rivalries (§11): one wild individual per run at a time; it takes the first wild battle of each later stage, can't be caught, and a hostile trainer rival may catch it and then always carries it.

sacrifice.note: §29: rare and only when every condition holds. The rival Pokémon (caught by a trainer) is that trainer's last Pokémon in reserve, and the attacker's hit would knock out its rival. Armed per battle by a seeded roll of its own.
